title: Marche Fuel Prices Climb as Summer Winds Down
dek: Self-service Benzina and Gasolio in Marche both undercut the national average this week, even as prices trend upward heading into late August.
body: In Marche, self-service Benzina is averaging €1.9988 per liter and self-service Gasolio €2.1289, as of August 20. Both figures sit just below the national self-service averages of €2.0141 for Benzina and €2.1442 for Gasolio — Marche drivers are paying roughly 1.5 cents less per liter than the rest of Italy on both fuels.

The regional trend has been gently upward: Benzina self-service crept from €1.9882 to €1.9988 over the past week, while Gasolio jumped more sharply, from €2.1118 to €2.1289 in the latest reading alone. Of Marche's 775 registered stations, 731 reported prices today — a 94% reporting rate that reflects an active, well-monitored regional network.
